en: A black-and-white postcard showing a grand, villa-type building partly obscured by tall trees, with steps leading up to the entrance and outdoor seating on the terrace. The caption at the bottom of the front side reads 'Bad Pyrmont Richters Pension, Brunnenstraße 16.' The reverse side features a handwritten message, a Deutsche Reich postage stamp, printed text describing 'Richters Pension, Bad Pyrmont,' and a museum stamp for 'Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' There is also decorative typography relating to Bad Pyrmont and a 1937 publishing date.
